sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Factory is a location in Escape from Tarkov. It is the first map that was added to the game.

sections.heading: Description
sections.text: The industrial estate and facilities of Chemical Plant No. 16 were rented out illegally to the TerraGroup corporation. During the advent of the Contract Wars, the plant became the scene of numerous firefights between BEAR and USEC that ultimately determined control over the industrial district of Tarkov. Later on, in the wake of the chaos, the plant facilities became a shelter for the remaining civilians, Scavs, and military operatives, including the scattered remains of the BEAR and USEC contingents.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text: Factory is initially only accessible by transiting. Direct access from the location selection screen is unlocked upon progressing through the story chapter Tour.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
- The night version of the location was added with patch patch 0.4.1.706 on November 22, 2017.
- The location was first expanded with patch 0.12.11.0.13074 on June 30, 2021.
- The location was completely reworked and expanded with patch 0.15.0.0.32128 on August 20, 2024.
